undercroft.name: BRIGHTWATER UNDERCROFT
undercroft.legend: # wall, . floor, ~ chasm, W deep water (swim), Y deep water that splits rooms, w/v sluice basins A/B, L sluice lever, ^ stairs, @ entrance, F campfire, B push block, P plate, b/r blue/red peg, C crystal switch, = shutter, k key door, K boss door, V sealed vault door, % cracked wall, 1-9 chest, t-y hook posts (undercroft), letters in foes/elite: enemies, ! sealed fight room, G boss, g arena gate

1.say: A SMALL KEY. IT OPENS ONE LOCKED DOOR.

2.say: THE UNDERCROFT MAP. EVERY ROOM IS ON THE MINIMAP NOW.

5.say: THE WARDEN'S SEAL. IT OPENS THE GREAT DOOR.

7.say: THE COMPASS. CHESTS AND THE BOSS SHOW ON YOUR MAP.

vault.locked: A SEALED VAULT. THERE'S A WAVE CARVED ON THE DOOR... SOMETHING FROM THE FEN.
vault.open: THE TIDE CHARM HUMS AND THE SEAL GIVES WAY

hints.text: THAT SLAB FITS THE PLATE. TAP IT TO SHOVE IT.
A SWITCH BEHIND THE PEGS. A RANGED HERO COULD HIT IT.
A SWITCH ON A PILLAR. THE HOOK COULD REACH IT.
TWO PLATES, TWO BLOCKS. MIND THE CORNERS.
THE VINE RUNS UNDER THAT GREAT DOOR.
FLOODED. LUCKY WE CAN SWIM NOW.

abbey.name: THE SUNKEN ABBEY
abbey.legend: # wall, . floor, ~ chasm, W deep water (swim), Y deep water that splits rooms, w/v sluice basins A/B, L sluice lever, ^ stairs, @ entrance, F campfire, B push block, P plate, b/r blue/red peg, C crystal switch, = shutter, k key door, K boss door, V sealed vault door, % cracked wall, 1-9 chest, t-y hook posts (undercroft), letters in foes/elite: enemies, ! sealed fight room, G boss, g arena gate

1.say: A SMALL KEY, GREEN WITH AGE.

2.say: THE ABBEY'S FLOOR PLAN. EVERY ROOM IS ON THE MINIMAP NOW.

4.say: ANOTHER SMALL KEY. THE BELL TOWER'S, MAYBE.

5.say: THE SANCTUM KEY. IT OPENS THE DOOR BENEATH THE WATER.

7.say: THE COMPASS. CHESTS AND THE BOSS SHOW ON YOUR MAP.

abbey.bossLock: A GREAT DOOR UNDER THE WATER. ITS LOCK IS SHAPED LIKE A BELL.

vault.locked: A SEALED VAULT. AN EYE IS CARVED ON THE DOOR... WE NEED A WAY TO SEE WHAT'S HIDDEN.
vault.open: THE LENS SEES THROUGH THE SEAL

hints.text: THE WAY IN IS FLOODED. THAT LEVER MIGHT MOVE THE WATER.
BASINS AND LEVERS. EACH PULL SENDS THE WATER TO THE OTHER BASIN.
THE PLATE'S UNDER WATER. DRAIN IT FIRST.
PEGS ALL THE WAY UP. A SWITCH ON EVERY LANDING.
THE VINE RUNS UP THE DROWNED AISLE, UNDER THAT GREAT DOOR.

cave.name: DROWNED HOLLOW
cave.legend: overlay: the cave's own tunnels; entities at absolute tiles

hints.text: A CRYSTAL SWITCH... AND PEGS ABOVE AND BELOW. ONE OPENS AS THE OTHER CLOSES.

witchroot.name: WITCHROOT HOLLOW
witchroot.legend: as the Abbey, plus: * brazier (lit by fire or the Lantern; a room's shutters wait for its braziers), I illusory wall (solid until the Seer's Lens), _ hidden bridge (chasm until the Seer's Lens)

1.say: A SMALL KEY, CARVED FROM ROOT AND STILL GROWING.

2.say: A MAP SCRATCHED ON BARK. EVERY TUNNEL IS ON THE MINIMAP NOW.

4.say: ANOTHER ROOT KEY. IT CREAKS WHEN YOU HOLD IT.

5.say: THE HUNT HORN. THE GREAT ROOT-DOOR WILL ANSWER IT.

7.say: A COMPASS WHOSE NEEDLE SHIVERS TOWARD WHATEVER'S HIDDEN.

witchroot.bossLock: A DOOR OF TWISTED ROOTS. A HORN-SHAPED KNOT SITS WHERE A LOCK SHOULD BE.

vault.locked: A VAULT SEALED WITH A HUGE STONE SLAB. NOTHING WE HAVE COULD SHIFT IT.
vault.open: THE GAUNTLETS HEAVE THE SLAB ASIDE

hints.text: IT'S PITCH DARK DOWN HERE. THOSE BRAZIERS COULD TAKE A FLAME.
A CRYSTAL ON THE FAR LEDGE. A BOW OR A SPELL COULD HIT IT FROM HERE.
THE VINE RUNS UNDER THAT DOOR OF ROOTS. THE HUNT LIVES DOWN HERE.
THE LENS SHOWS A BRIDGE OF LIGHT ACROSS THE CHASM!
THREE MORE BRAZIERS. THE ALCOVE WON'T OPEN IN THE DARK.

forge.name: THE FORGE OF ASH
forge.legend: as the Abbey, plus: & lava, O heavy boulder (needs the Stone Gauntlets; rolls into lava to fill it), X reinforced wall (only the Gauntlets break it)

1.say: A SMALL KEY, STILL WARM FROM THE FORGE.

2.say: A DWARVEN PLAN OF THE FORGE, SCRATCHED INTO A COPPER PLATE.

4.say: A HEAVY IRON KEY. THE DWARVES DIDN'T DO DAINTY.

5.say: THE MASTER'S BRAND. THE GREAT FORGE DOOR WAS MADE TO ANSWER IT.

7.say: A COMPASS WITH A NEEDLE OF COLD IRON. IT POINTS AT EVERYTHING HIDDEN.

forge.bossLock: THE GREAT FORGE DOOR. A BRAND-SHAPED SOCKET GLOWS IN ITS FACE.

vault.locked: A VAULT HALF FULL OF STILL WATER. A SEAL OF TIDES IS CARVED ON THE DOOR.
vault.open: THE TIDE CHARM ANSWERS THE SEAL OF TIDES

hints.text: A BLOCK AND A PLATE. THE DWARVES LIKED THEIR DOORS HEAVY.
A CRYSTAL ACROSS THE LAVA. SOMEONE WITH A BOW OR A SPELL, PLEASE.
THE VINE GOES UNDER THE GREAT FORGE DOOR. TOWARD THE HEARTH.
THAT IRON-STRAPPED WALL IN THE CORNER, ABOVE THE LAVA... WITH THESE GAUNTLETS ON, I COULD BREAK IT.
A BOULDER BY THE LAVA... WITH THE GAUNTLETS WE COULD ROLL IT IN.
TWO BOULDERS, TWO PLATES. THE GAUNTLETS CAN MANAGE THAT.

clawhold.name: THE CLAWHOLD
clawhold.legend: as the Undercroft (no boss): foes f frost wolf, q ice wraith, s hex sentinel

1.say: A TRAPPER'S KEY ON A LOOP OF GUT. IT SMELLS OF WOLF.

hints.text: A BLOCK AND A PLATE. THE TRAPPERS WANTED THIS DOOR TO STAY SHUT.
BONES. FUR. FRESH TRACKS. WE'RE IN THEIR DEN.
A LOCKED DOOR. THE TRAPPERS KEPT THE GOOD STUFF BEHIND IT.

spire.name: THE RIMEGLASS SPIRE
spire.legend: as the Witchroot, plus: J glide pad (a wind vent on a chasm's lip; the Gale Cloak glides across), M Mirelle frozen in ice (thaws when her room's braziers burn); foes f frost wolf, q ice wraith, s hex sentinel, m rimehorn

1.say: A SMALL SILVER KEY, ENGRAVED WITH STARS.

2.say: AN ASTRONOMER'S CHART OF THE TOWER, INKED ON A STAR MAP.

5.say: THE STAR-KEY. THE GREAT DOOR TO THE MIRROR CHAMBER WAS MADE FOR IT.

7.say: A COMPASS WHOSE NEEDLE IS A SLIVER OF RIMEGLASS. IT POINTS AT WHAT'S HIDDEN.

spire.bossLock: THE GREAT DOOR TO THE MIRROR CHAMBER. A STAR-SHAPED LOCK GLITTERS IN ITS FACE.

vault.locked: A VAULT SEALED WITH A SLAB OF SOLID RIMEGLASS. IT WOULD TAKE ENORMOUS STRENGTH TO SHIFT.
vault.open: THE STONE GAUNTLETS HEAVE THE SLAB ASIDE

hints.text: THE VINE CLIMBS ON UP THE TOWER. THE ASTRONOMERS KEPT THEIR STAR-MIRROR AT THE TOP.
A CHASM, WITH WIND HOWLING UP OUT OF IT. THOSE VENTS ON THE EDGE... WITH SOMETHING TO CATCH THE WIND...
SOMEONE'S FROZEN IN THE ICE THERE! AND TWO COLD BRAZIERS. FIRE MIGHT THAW HER.
THE VINE GOES UNDER THAT GREAT DOOR. THE MIRROR'S BEHIND IT.

tower1.name: THE NINTH TOWER - FLOOR 1
tower1.legend: as the Abbey: a floor of the Ninth Tower (Hexborn foes); a Ward Echo floor ends in its lieutenant's arena

hints.text: THE NINTH TOWER. EVERY WARD STONE WE BROKE SEALED A FLOOR. WHATEVER'S LEFT, WE CLIMB.

hints.text: A BLOCK, A PLATE, AND A SHUT DOOR. MALGRIM DOES LIKE HIS LITTLE GAMES.

hints.text: THE TOP OF THE TOWER. HE'S UP THERE. I CAN FEEL HIM LOOKING.
